semantic_rubric.description: The article carries only material present in the draft: no invented fact, number, proper noun, anecdote, error message, or command output, and no measurement claim where the draft says nothing was measured.
Colloquial or self-deprecating asides appear at most twice in the whole article, zero is acceptable, and they are not placed one per section ending or at any other regular interval.
Where the draft supplies no concrete detail for a general statement, the general statement is cut rather than filled with a fabricated example, and the article is allowed to end up short.
